description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Act, No. 40 of 2014 - Amended Gaz. Ex. No. 2308/52 on 2022.12.02, Published under Gaz. Ex. No. 2339/10 - dated 04.07.2023
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Power and Energy under the Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Act, No. 40 of 2014. It establishes legal requirements and regulatory frameworks for the security of radioactive sources, including licensing requirements, compliance procedures, and enforcement mechanisms. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
